purpose: Descriptive provenance and review queue for the current development manuscript; not a new publication-eligibility audit.
review_semantics: Evidence locators identify material for inspection. A recorded result, passing software check, author scope decision or model classification does not establish support for a broader scientific claim. Every manuscript claim below still requires responsible-author review for this draft.

claims.claim: The released contract represents six substantive dimensions plus institutional-record integrity and assessment-packet integrity, using dimension-specific finding rules.
claims.boundary: Implementation does not establish that the dimensions adequately measure practical control.

claims.claim: The historical audit reports six eligible mapped claims and detects eight specified corruptions; its implementation aggregates recorded judgments.
claims.boundary: Recorded integrity/support states are not independently authenticated by their declaration; fitness is not automatically measured. No eligibility transfers to this draft.

claims.claim: Two eligible independent scorers agreed on seven items in one frozen Cigna packet under scorer contract 0.1.0.
claims.boundary: One case, two scorers and one substantive category pattern; no population reliability, construct validity or current-contract replication.

claims.claim: The Ofqual complete-record application is an exploratory automation-boundary example with source and period restrictions.
claims.boundary: Acceptance of suitability as a bounded example does not accept scores, interpretations or comparative outcomes.

claims.claim: The preserved AI draft has an additive author adjudication: bounded positive findings and limited status for both integrity components are accepted; Counsel and the comparison remain unresolved.
claims.boundary: Acceptance covers stated event-level and limited-integrity interpretations only. The request to examine a missed distinction or loss accepts neither a tie nor an established loss. No independent source review, manuscript approval, publication eligibility, equivalence result or user benefit follows.

claims.claim: Four retained within-assistant reanalyses are supplemented by three separately frozen period, conflict and formatting argument analyses; the extension records eighteen proposed paired ties pending author review.
claims.boundary: No independent rescoring, statistical sensitivity estimate, replacement categories or empirical equivalence. No new evaluation API call occurred; contributing-assistant reasoning did. The selected-passage model screen remains separate.

claims.claim: The first retained model batch matched eight assistant-authored expectations in eight exposed development items.
claims.boundary: No independently adjudicated accuracy estimate, human-time saving or HIT validation.

claims.claim: The second batch matched nine of ten frozen expectations; the date disagreement remains unresolved.
claims.boundary: The handling decision does not establish a model error or settle event identity.

claims.claim: The Ofqual advisory run returned fourteen valid responses, with six natural propositions classified supported and declared paired relations observed once.
claims.boundary: No human reference labels, pooled accuracy, full-document assessment, general robustness or scientific acceptance; classification reservations remain.

claims.claim: Reviewed adjacent research already addresses oversight limits, practical ability and authority, audit artifacts and claim-evidence arguments.
claims.boundary: Purposive reviewed passages, not systematic coverage or evidence that other methods lack particular features. Source-level author review remains pending.

claims.claim: Version 0.6.6 has a verified exact-version archive; later records require their own revision identification.
claims.boundary: Archival publication is not acceptance of scientific judgments or evidence that this development manuscript was included in that archive.

claims.claim: Current-contract replication, independent implementation, construct validity and comparative benefit remain unresolved.

evidence.locator: Construct validity and operational usefulness evaluation

claims.boundary: Software completion, archival publication and authorization to proceed do not close these obligations.

claims.claim: An additive file/dependency check binds the historical map's thirteen claims and nineteen evidence references to actual tracked files and a pinned base without recomputing scientific eligibility.
claims.boundary: File identity and graph consistency do not establish source truth, human support review, evidence fitness or publication eligibility. The historical evaluator and audit remain unchanged.

claims.claim: An additive comparison challenge identifies distinctions omitted by a restricted category projection but retained in the full HIT rationales; the baseline shares HIT evidence infrastructure.

claims.boundary: The author requested a challenge, not acceptance of a tie or a loss. Inspectable omission from selected fields does not demonstrate full-method inferiority, reader error, comparative burden or net benefit. No such outcomes were measured.
